title: Didn't Help As Much As I Had Hoped
text: Didn't Help As Much As I Had Hoped. We have a sofa that sinks on one of the cushions. I had hoped that this would help. Unfortunately it didn't help as much as I had hoped. So I'm guessing our problem is the actual cushion not the foundation of the sofa where this would be more useful. This does require assembly. It's difficult to put together by yourself, so my husband and I did it together. It seems sturdy enough that it would do the job if the springs or base of your furniture was the cause of your sinking.
